name: georgestephanis/timesheets
description: Single-file CLI tool that aggregates ActivityWatch, Chrome history, and git commits into a project-based activity report.

scripts-descriptions.serve: Start the PHP web UI at http://localhost:8000
scripts-descriptions.report: Run the CLI report (pass flags after --: composer report -- --days 3 --from 2026-05-01)
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check PHP code style (PSR-12 via phpcs)
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix PHP code style issues (via phpcbf)
scripts-descriptions.analyze: Run PHPStan static analysis at level 5
scripts-descriptions.check: Run all checks: PHP lint, JSON format, PHPStan, and PHPUnit
